The course is quite informative. Presents a survey of American law's historical trajectory through examples in literature and real life material. No weak aspects.

Strongest: A course that allows you to examine the legal system, one of the most interesting aspects of American Culture. What makes the course even more interesting is that it examines the reflection of law in literary texts rather than a simple law course. It is a literature and philosophy course rather than a law course. We also read famous cases, french philosophers, essays, and novels. We examined artworks and advertisements related to the topic. Weakest: It is not a weak point, but one should choose the course knowing that this is not a LAW course and the professor is not knowledgeable in the law, in terms of knowing the whole American legal system.
